checks.decision: The corrected independent run issued 971 localhost requests and passed every check. All 276 paginated all-subject pages returned the 6,603 source-ordered records exactly once. All 598 populated root/immediate-child scopes partitioned the same 6,603 records, and five complete search traversals matched the independent Unicode-NFKC, lowercase, punctuation-normalized AND-term oracle. The retained author rerun also reports 55/55 checks passing; the retained production build returned zero.

List responses are limited to 24 records; detail children are limited to 24 with an explicit total and navigation link; the frozen maximum incident-reference and collection-member counts are both 62, below the 512 load boundary. Twenty-one malformed, duplicate, mixed, unknown, oversized and invalid-page GET requests returned structured HTTP 400 responses with Cache-Control no-store. The exact 300-character limit and page 1,000,000 were accepted, POST returned 405, and malformed dynamic subject routes returned 404.

This product gate starts from the exact three adapter outputs independently approved by the separate source/import audit. Against those bytes, seven selected API details matched independently reconstructed source records exactly, including original descriptions and locators, all relation source IDs and RDF predicate/endpoints, conditional qualifier URIs and literal metadata, the 62-member collection target, hierarchy and label disagreements, an empty leaf, TeX-looking text and the 62-incident maximum case. This reviewer did not repeat the raw CSV/Turtle import audit.

The frozen catalogue, route and server-rendered page code implement the contracted hierarchy, lexical search, strict read-only API, directed reference display, collection handling and source text escaping. Selected HTML response bodies contain the required attribution, terms, exact descriptions, qualifiers, collection members, disagreement explanations and bounded-scope caveats. The final documentation and CI supplement passed 20/20 static alignment checks, including the corrected detail-versus-list wording, implemented wrapper/importer flags, three byte comparisons and retained CI artifacts.

resolved_findings: DOC-01: Detail-versus-list API wording was corrected and rechecked.
HARNESS-01: The first auditor run's React comment-marker false negative was corrected; the original failed result remains retained.
limitations: This review covers the exact frozen product source, data, documentation, workflows and localhost HTTP responses. It does not certify a later edit.
The raw CSV/Turtle importer is covered by a separate independent audit; this gate verifies the product against its exact reviewed JSON outputs.
The GitHub workflows were checked for frozen text, file existence and command/flag alignment, but were not executed on GitHub by this reviewer.
No browser DOM, screenshot, responsive-layout, assistive-technology or general visual evaluation was performed or claimed.
No classification record or lexical result is certified as a proof, semantic equivalence, prerequisite, exhaustive account of mathematics, novelty result or open-problem determination.
